card.name: Dose adjustment wording during infusion reactions
card.fires_on: Words in label instructions about changing, slowing, interrupting or resuming an infusion or dose after a reaction, such as 'infusion' after 'increase', 'reduce', or 'may be required'. It also fires on pieces of brand names in the same instructions.

modes.label: Infusion rate changes
modes.description: Words about raising, lowering, or resuming an infusion rate after an event.

modes.description: Middle pieces of brand names in infusion-reaction instructions.
